newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end sharply higher, Repsol in focus.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end sharply higher, Repsol in focus.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended sharply higher on Monday buoyed by substantial bond market gains and against a backdrop of strength in other European bourses.
Focus was on Repsol, which started the process for the privatisation of the State's last 10.00 percent stake.
The general index rose 10.23 points, 2.19 percent, to 476.35 and the Ibex added 125.04 points, 2.34 percent, to 5,461.13.
Repsol rose 120 pesetas to 5,960 as the period for provisional share orders started. Heavy demand is expected.
Telefonica added 90 pesetas to 3,390, rebounding from last week's weakness and ahead of expected news of a U.S. partner.
Dealers said there were possibilities of further gains short term after a period of weakness. But the volatility factor made some edgy.

"After nervousness in the past few sessions we've now got everyone in a hurry to buy, whereas the best thing would be some kind of middle ground, with a steadier and more continuous recovery," said a dealer.
Some said expectations of benign March inflation data, due this week, were prompting hopes of a cut in key money rates, also underpinnning today's gains.
